Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(amf): annotated video v3 — pixel-precise, non-invasive red boxes (zero text overlap, machine-verified)

Operator feedback: v2's percentage-placed boxes grazed text on the right/
bottom edges. v3 maps each highlighted block's exact text extents from the
frame pixels, pads into the blank gutters, and iteratively nudges any edge
whose 3px stroke would cross a glyph. Final audit: all 8 box strokes across
the 6 annotated stills cross ZERO text pixels (brightness>90 count = 0 under
every ring). Strokes thinned 8px -> 3px for a less invasive look. The fr08
netscan strip (only a 1px gap above its header) was re-targeted to the
honest-negative sentence, which has clean 22px gutters and is the line that
matters anyway.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(amf): narration kit v2 — still-based annotated video (boxes no longer drift)

Operator feedback: v1 drew boxes over the scrolling source video, so the
highlights drifted off their targets as text moved. v2 rebuilds the annotated
video from seven steady stills (one per key moment, extracted from the source;
original still untouched) with tight red boxes that never move, joined at
narration-friendly durations (1:19 total; the dense battery scene now holds
20s for its 20s line). NARRATION-SCRIPT.md retimed to match; cmdline/transition
rows folded in. 1.1MB vs v1's 24MB as a bonus.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

anti-hallucination safeguard, the SIMULATED-approval disclosure + HMAC record,
and the sealed report). Box windows derived from frame-by-frame study.

NARRATION-SCRIPT.md: the matching timestamped script — per segment: what is
boxed on screen and the first-person line to record, with the ffmpeg mux
command and pacing tips. The boxes double as recording cue cards. Working kit
for the ⚠ pending narrated demo video (requirement #2).
